narr: A cluster of strong to severe thunderstorms dropped south from middle Tennessee into north Alabama. Strong winds associated knocked down a few trees. Power outages (up to 20,000 people affected) were reported over a large part of central and northwest Madison County. At least one foot of flood water was reported on one northern Madison County roadway.
ev: Social media report/video of one foot of flood water on Patterson Lane in multiple locations. Time estimated by radar.
